reason: The README describes a HarmonyOS development assistant primarily centered on hdc-based device inspection, UI interaction, application lifecycle testing, crash diagnosis, and DevEco build and emulator workflows.

summaries.zh: 面向鸿蒙开发者的设备调试插件，集成 hdc 设备 निरी查、截图、UI 操作、应用测试、崩溃诊断以及 DevEco 构建和模拟器控制。
summaries.en: A HarmonyOS development plugin for hdc device inspection, screenshots, UI interaction, application testing, crash diagnosis, and DevEco build and emulator workflows.

capabilities: Executes local hdc and DevEco CLI commands
Captures screenshots and writes them to the workspace
Performs device UI actions and application lifecycle operations
Installs, signs, builds, runs, and removes HarmonyOS applications
Controls emulator state and injects device conditions
Reads local SDK and DevEco Studio metadata and documentation
